scripts.lint: oxlint && pnpm --dir packages/dms-builder/frontend-vue lint && antelopejs-check-interface-ranges && pnpm --filter @antelopejs/dms-builder check:package-contract && pnpm --filter @antelopejs/dms-builder check:frontend-source
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @antelopejs/dms-builder test:node && pnpm --dir packages/dms-builder/frontend-vue test && pnpm --dir packages/dms-builder/frontend-vue test:components
